item.title: n2-013 - The Greenwood Boys
item.description: 课文 Paraphrase pop singers - all parts of the country. will be arriving, tomorrow - coming by train, young people, meeting tmr evening, singing at … - staying for 5 days during - give 5 performances. as usual, police, keep order - on these occasions Grammar 1. 将来进行时 [[future-continuous-tense|将来进行时]] : will be doing. 表示将来正在做。

item.title: 将来进行时
item.description: 将来进行时 表示 “将来正在进行的事情“ ， 在通常指的是已经安排好的事情。 (预料之中， 按计划会发生) 需要注意 进行时态 (be + V-ing) 的核心是描述动态的、持续的动作。 所以将来进行时也需要表达这种状态的持续。 1. 情态动词引导将来进行时 shall / will be doing. 对比 现在进行时 和 将来进行时 I am doing homework now. I shall be doing homework all day tomorrow. She is getting ready for the party. She will be getting ready for the party tomorrow.
